name: Adept AkashicEQFlow
plain: Builds step positions from a density in log-SNR space, peaked near logSNR≈0, and inverts its CDF. Step placement adapts with step count. Code names EQ-VAE models as its target.
math:
λ=−2 ln σ. center=.20+.15·clamp((n−16)/30,0,1); u_c=clamp((center−λmin)/Δλ,.12,.88); density(t)=1+c·exp(−((t−u_c)/w)²/2)+.15t^1.2+.10(1−t)^1.5, c=clamp(.8+n/20,1,2.2), w=clamp(.40−.003n,.22,.38).
u_i=CDF⁻¹(i/(n−1)), σ_i=exp(−(λmin+u_i·Δλ)/2); ends forced to σmax, σmin, then 0.
label: from code

audit.note: adept_schedulers.py:609 docstring says EQ-VAE models, not SDXL; SDXL appears only on other schedules (:86, :482). Math omits the u_c clamp at :633 and the forced end values at :669-670.
